FlipSid3 Tactics (alt. Flipside Tactics and abbreviated as F3) was an American esports organization. They have previously hosted three Swedish squads and a CIS squad. They also housed a South African squad under the name of FlipSid3 Tactics.za as well as an academy lineup from the United States, under the name of FlipSid3 Tactics Academy.

  • March 28th - FlipSid3 Tactics acquire the highgrade roster: barsiC, windster, zape, relIk and hydrox join. [1]
  • April 23rd - windster leaves.
  • April 24th - Jumpy joins.
  • July 14th - FlipSid3 Tactics announce a new Swedish squad: MODDII, schneider, pyth, twist and cENTRYZ join. [2]
  • August 6th - Spitfire replaces pyth. [3]
  • August 19th - MODDII leaves. [4]
  • August 26th - Jumpy replaces twist. [5]
  • September 16 - FlipSid3 Tactics disbands their Swedish squad. [6]
  • September 24th - FlipSid3 Tactics announce new a Swedish squad: twist, berg, BENDJI, robiin and Dumas join. [7]
  • October 21st - robiin leaves due to his VAC Ban from May 2013. zende joins to fill the gap left by robiin. [8]
  • December 23rd - FlipSid3 Tactics part ways with BENDJI and Dumas. [9]
  • December 31st - FlipSid3 Tactics sign schneider and pauf. [10]
  • January 27th - FlipSid3 Tactics part ways with their lineup. [11]
  • February 1st - FlipSid3 Tactics sign dAT Team: B1ad3, WorldEdit, bondik, s1mple and markeloff join. [12]
  • July 17th - s1mple steps off the active roster, following internal problems culminating at ESWC 2015. [13], but remains being contracted under the organization.
  • October 23rd - FlipSid3 Tactics release s1mple. [14]
  • April 20th - bondik's contract with FlipSid3 Tactics expires and he leaves the team. [15]
  • April 26th - FlipSid3 Tactics sign kane as their head coach. [16]
  • June 20th - FlipSid3 Tactics acquire wayLander from Gambit Gaming. [17]
  • September 21st - FlipSid3 Tactics sign electronic on trial; Shara steps off the active roster. [18]
  • November 6th - electronic leaves the team to join Natus Vincere, FlipSid3 Tactics sign seized on loan to replace him. [19]
  • January 14th - seized's loan ends with FlipSid3 Tactics and he returns to Natus Vincere. [20]
  • April 20th - lollipop21k is signed from GoodJob. [21]
  • July 19th - WorldEdit and lollipop21k are transfer listed. B1ad3 becomes coach. [22]
  • July 24th - B1ad3 is loaned to Gambit Esports as their coach till September 30th. [23]
  • July 30th - lollipop21k departs the team. [24]
  • October 7th - FlipSid3 Tactics and Gambit Esports reach an agreement to extend B1ad3's loan until the end of October. [25]
  • October 19th - wayLander and WorldEdit part ways with FlipSid3 Tactics to join Winstrike Team. [26]
  • March 17th - B1ad3's loan to Gambit Esports ends and he becomes a free agent. [27]
